operation: Edit using the staged Whetstorm HUD launcher icon as a style reference
prompt: Edit the referenced Whetstorm HUD launcher icon into a clear SPELLBOOK launcher. Replace the dagger and whetstone completely with one closed, upright fantasy spellbook viewed at a slight three-quarter angle: a thick deep teal-blue leather cover, a few worn bronze corner fittings, and one simple luminous pale-blue star on the cover. Match the reference's hand-painted stylized fantasy game style, warm upper-left light, chunky forms, bold near-black outline and restrained detail. Center the whole book with a small safe margin. Its silhouette must be immediately recognizable as a book at 24 pixels, and distinct from a medal or achievement badge. Real transparent alpha background. No person, hands, weapons, whetstone, scenery, border, frame, text, lettering, logo, or watermark.
